sharetrawl
	

256,902 publicly-shared LLM conversations across 9 platforms including toxic output.
Last updated: 2026-11-22
This dataset extends ShareChat (paper) and is updated weekly. 74,999 of its 256,902 urls came from ShareChat's list (29%) rather than from our own discovery.
Have share links this corpus is missing? Paste them at https://sharetrawl-submit.hails.workers.dev
